title: GameNavigationGuard
responsibility: Protect unsaved game edits during app navigation, browser unload and native window lifecycle decisions.

inputs.name: GameNavigationGuard.active
inputs.description: Turns the guard on or off; it is read each time a navigation is about to start, and only its truthiness is tested, with no type check. When true, a navigation flagged willUnload is always cancelled and any other navigation is cancelled unless window.confirm('Discard unsaved game changes?') returns true; when false, nothing is cancelled.

outputs.name: GameNavigationGuard
outputs.description: Renders no visible markup: its template holds only HTML comments. Each instance calls beforeNavigate once during setup, registering a callback that, while active is true, cancels navigations flagged willUnload and cancels other navigations unless window.confirm('Discard unsaved game changes?') returns true, and does nothing while active is false.
